name: Arcana: Heartbreak Rhapsody
source:
Fall into the middle of a bizarre love triangle after landing the role of lead singer in a struggling band with Asra, Julian, Muriel, and Porta.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
在与Asra、Julian、Muriel和Porta组成的一支陷入困境的乐队中担任主唱后，陷入了一段离奇的三角恋。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
